species: evaluate the function of protein domains during hepatocyte specification from human pluripotent stem cells.
tissue: During mammalian development, liver differentiation is driven by signals that converge on multiple transcription factor networks.
cell_type: we examined alterations in the proteome at differentiation day 9 from WT, DBD Mut, and SUMO Mut lines.
sample_source: Following genome editing, one WT, one homozygous deletion mutant (DBD Mut), and one point mutated clone (SUMO Mut) were expanded, differentiated, and characterized in detail.
cell_line: WT human embryonic stem cells transited through definitive endoderm stage (differentiation day 3) (Figures S1A and S1B) and then gave rise to polygonal hepatic progenitors (differentiation day 9) (Figure 2A).
